description: Local Authorities and County Councils within UK Power Networks licence areas is a dataset listed in UK Power Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by UK Power Networks. Introduction Shapefile showing local authority boundaries within the UK Power Networks area (across all licence areas). District/Borough councils, Unitary Authorities, and County Councils are shown. Methodological Approach Data Extraction: Static shapefiles were exported from the Office of National Statistics' website. Source: Local Authorities, County Councils and Regions. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Supporting Information. The portal shows 2025-01-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ukpn-open-data-portal.
